title: Eaton Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q1 2026 net sales were USD 7.451 billion, net income attributable to ordinary shareholders was USD 866 million, diluted EPS was USD 2.22, operating cash flow was USD 507 million, cash was USD 565 million, and total debt was USD 21.129 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed quarterly report supports current revenue, earnings, diluted-share, cash-flow, acquisition leverage, working-capital, segment-demand, and risk analysis for Eaton; it predates the scheduled Q2 2026 review.
